title: Salvia officinalis tincture for medicinal use
intro: Salvia officinalis tincture is a concentrated liquid preparation made by soaking the leaves of the common sage plant in alcohol or another suitable solvent. It is commonly used in herbalism for its purported antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and cognitive-enhancing properties. This tincture is often employed to support respiratory health, aid digestion, and promote mental clarity. It may also be used topically to treat skin conditions or as a gargle for sore throats. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its ability to balance bodily humors and enhance vitality.
